title: DMind Benchmark: Toward a Holistic Assessment of LLM Capabilities across the Web3 Domain

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the consistency and potential bias of LLM judges on subjective questions by comparing each judge's scores to a leave-one-out ensemble average of other judges, calculating the mean signed difference (Mean Bias Δ), mean absolute error, and correlation metrics.

Conducting an inter-annotator agreement (IAA) study among human domain experts using metrics like Krippendorff's alpha, Fleiss' kappa, and ICC(2,k) to validate the reliability of the subjective scoring rubric and empirically address concerns about viewpoint or regional bias.
